question_en:
I am creating a set of displays themed "Award-Winning Records and Performers" for a music festival. The attachment is an album cover image that does not show the album title or the artist's name. Please answer the following questions:

1. What are the title of the album in the image and its primary credited artist? For which edition and in which category was this album nominated as a whole album, and did it ultimately win?
2. Among the other albums nominated in the same category at that edition (including the final winner), which albums clearly show string instruments on the front covers of their standard editions at initial release? Please list the album titles and the string instruments appearing on the covers.

Answer format: For Part 1, provide the album, main artist, award edition, category, and result in text. For Part 2, list the album titles and the string instruments on the covers in a table.
answer:
Part 1: Album: Me/And/Dad; Main Artist: Billy Strings; 66th Grammy Awards (2024) Best Bluegrass Album; Result: Nominated, did not win.

Part 2:

| Album Title | String Instruments on Cover |
| --- | --- |
| Radio John: Songs of John Hartford | Mandolin |
| Lovin' Of The Game | Violin (fiddle) |
| Mighty Poplar | Violin (fiddle), Banjo, Acoustic Guitar, Mandolin, Double Bass |
| City Of Gold | Acoustic Guitar |
